card.name: Just before Spanish El/La names
card.fires_on: Small words or the word El itself, right before a Spanish article-led name such as El Niño, Los Angeles, El Chico or la casa. It fires in general web text about places, climate events and Spanish.

modes.description: Punctuation or a list marker leading into a Spanish sentence beginning with la.
